pair.description: In the planner, open the project and create a pairing code for Home Assistant.

data_description.planner_url: The web address of your Maxsen Planner, starting with https://

upload.title: Upload a home file
upload.description: Choose the home file (.json) exported from the Maxsen Planner.

reconfigure.title: Pair with the Maxsen Planner again
reconfigure.description: For a disconnected home, a new planner address, or a home added from a file. In the planner, open this home's project and create a pairing code for Home Assistant. The drawing, links, quick panel and scenes stay as they are.

data_description.planner_url: The web address of your Maxsen Planner, starting with https://
data_description.code: The code shown in the planner. It works once.

error.too_many: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the planner. Check the address and your connection.
error.not_ready: The planner has no home to send yet: {message}
error.invalid_url: Enter the planner address starting with https://
error.invalid_file: This is not a Maxsen home file.
error.unsupported_version: This home file is from a newer planner. Update this integration.
error.too_large: This file is larger than 100 MB.

abort.wrong_project: That pairing code is for a different project. Create the code in this home's project in the planner.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Paired again. Refresh from planner works for this home now.
